name: Mojo — Pocket Capture
description:
Pocket Capture turns field lead capture — QR codes, links, and forms at events, booths, and sites — into something you can just *ask about*. Connect it and talk to your own capture operation in plain language: who to follow up with, how a capture point is converting, whether adoption is growing, and whether anything in your setup is broken or going to waste.

It can also **propose** new capture forms and capture points for you — but it never creates anything on its own. Proposals land in Pocket Capture as drafts that you review and approve; nothing goes live until you say so.

The connector is **read by default** (every tool touching data tool is read-only), and it only ever sees your own captured leads and setup — never anything else. It's built **write** for the operator who wants more leverage over their pipeline, not more process.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mojo — Pocket Capture to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mojo — Pocket Capture to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mojosystems.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mojo — Pocket Capture MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mojo — Pocket Capture lists 16 MCP tools, including capture_point_stats, capture_velocity, create_draft, data_quality, get_creation_contract, get_draft, get_lead, list_capture_points, list_drafts, list_forms, list_tasks, and plan_for_goal.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mojo — Pocket Capture?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mojo — Pocket Capture in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Mojo — Pocket Capture MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mojo — Pocket Capture requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mojo — Pocket Capture is developed by Mojo Systems LLC. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
